q: Symmetric encryption ke baare mein kaun sa sahi hai?
options: Public aur private key ka pair use hota hai
Encrypt aur decrypt ke liye ek hi shared key, aur ye fast hoti hai
Ye hamesha asymmetric se slow hoti hai
Isme key share karne ki zaroorat nahi
explain: Symmetric encryption (AES) ek hi key dono taraf use karti hai aur fast hai; iski samasya key safely share karna hai.

q: Password store karne ke liye sabse sahi tareeka kya hai?
options: Plain text mein
Base64 encoding karke
Salt ke saath hashing (bcrypt/argon2)
Symmetric encryption se
explain: Passwords ko salt ke saath hash karna chahiye (bcrypt/argon2). Hashing one-way hai, isliye leak hone par bhi original password nahi milta.

q: SQL injection se bachne ka sabse accha tareeka kya hai?
options: Parameterized queries (prepared statements) use karna
HTTP ki jagah HTTPS use karna
Base64 encoding
Firewall band kar dena
explain: User input ko seedha query mein jodne se SQL injection hota hai. Parameterized queries input ko data ki tarah treat karti hain, code ki tarah nahi.

q: IDS aur IPS mein mukhya farak kya hai?
options: IDS block karta hai, IPS sirf alert deta hai
Dono bilkul same hain
IDS sirf detect kar ke alert deta hai, IPS detect kar ke block bhi karta hai
IDS encryption karta hai, IPS decryption
explain: IDS attack detect kar ke alert deta hai (monitor), jabki IPS inline hota hai aur attack ko block bhi kar deta hai.

q: TLS 1.3 handshake ke baare mein kaun sa sahi hai?
options: Saara data asymmetric key (RSA) se encrypt hota hai
ECDHE se ek symmetric session key banti hai aur data usi se encrypt hota hai
Koi certificate zaroori nahi
Handshake mein kam se kam 5 round trip lagte hain
explain: TLS asymmetric crypto se ek symmetric session key set karta hai (ECDHE), phir fast symmetric encryption (AES) se data bhejta hai. TLS 1.3 ek round trip mein ho jaata hai.
